target_profile.system_boundary: Captured OmniPaxos core, storage implementations and optional in-repository runtime. Networking and application state machine are caller responsibilities; injected storage implementations remain part of the relevant boundary.
protocol_contexts: Static configured instance, leader ballots, follower synchronization sessions
Terminal StopSign followed by caller-created new configuration
ownership: Mutable core API serializes each instance; caller owns network delivery
Storage backend owns atomic transaction implementation; runtime actor is in repository

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Prepare selects highest accepted history using per-node promises; Accept counts per-node acknowledged indexes under current ballot and propagates decisions.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: BLE proposes leadership; SequencePaxos acquires authority with persistent promises and Prepare quorum. Old ballot and sequence guards restrict consumption.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Restart, reconnect and missing sequence trigger PrepareReq; retry callbacks restore prepared participation.
Validated cluster settings define participant list and quorums. StopSign seals an instance; caller installs the next configuration.
Read APIs expose decided entries and compacted snapshots; application execution is outside the core library.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: InternalStorage and captured MemoryStorage implement history access and synchronization; generic Storage requires atomic ordered transactions.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Raw callers drive ticks, network and reads; in-repository runtime adds asynchronous tracked completion and remains partially unmapped.

facts.meaning: Stored ballot currently promised by this replica; acceptance guards compare incoming ballots with this context.
facts.validity_context: From promise installation until a newer Prepare or local leader acquisition; equal promise can reenter Prepare in recovery.
facts.durability: Written through Storage; durability depends on chosen backend, MemoryStorage does not survive process loss.
facts.recovery: Construction loads promise and starts Recover with PrepareReq.

facts.meaning: Replica records a decided boundary used to label log entries and expose its compacted history; this numeric state alone does not establish correctness of transferred snapshot contents.
facts.validity_context: Current stored log/snapshot representation and accepted round; changed by quorum decision, follower decision or synchronization.
facts.durability: Backend persistence and atomic synchronization requirements apply.
facts.recovery: Cache reloads persisted index/log/snapshot and protocol resynchronizes.

facts.meaning: A produced Delta snapshot represents sender decided changes from the reported receiver decided index to the sender log decided boundary, excluding a final StopSign.

identity.transfer: LogSync carried by Promise or AcceptSync

facts.validity_context: Snapshot path when sender decided index exceeds common prefix and receiver reported decided index exceeds sender compacted index; receiver base history is required separately.
facts.durability: Message value; not persisted until consumed by sync_log.
facts.recovery: Produced during Prepare/Promise or AcceptSync, with complete-snapshot alternative when base is compacted at sender.
unknowns: Consumer must reconstruct the correct old base; current cached boundary is changed before reconstruction.

surfaces.reason: New decided index is assigned before reconstructing old snapshot base; selected for investigation.
Ordering omits configuration id; routing responsibility needs investigation before attributing cross-configuration input.
Runtime completes by assigned index before testing supersession; assignment producer and full legal history remain unread.
Accepted-index vector is sized by maximum pid rather than participant count; consequences for sparse ids require separate review.

formation.explanation: The local leader flushes/batches proposals and sends AcceptDecide only after Prepare collected a read quorum and adopted maximum accepted-round/index history. Followers in the promised ballot and Accept phase append ordered traffic and reply Accepted. The leader counts distinct pid slots against a write quorum, persists the chosen decided index and sends Decide or piggybacks it. Followers flush as needed and expose decided entries through read APIs. Append admission itself is not completion.

context.explanation: BLE heartbeat rounds select potential authority; try_become_leader is also public. SequencePaxos only acquires a strictly higher local ballot, persists its promise, clears leader support and requests promises. Receiving a higher Prepare flushes pending batches, persists promise and resets follower sequencing. Prior ballot accept/decide traffic is rejected; phase and session/counter checks protect ordered acceptance. Recovery starts from persisted promise and uses PrepareReq to allow equal-ballot Prepare. Reconfiguration replicates a terminal StopSign and leaves new instance startup/state transfer to callers.

connection.explanation: Promises report accepted round/index and decided boundary. The new leader selects the highest accepted history, retains the maximum reported decided boundary and synchronizes before admitting new formation. AcceptSync transfers the selected suffix or snapshot and starts a new per-follower sequence session; follower acknowledgment then feeds decision accounting in the leader ballot. Pending batches are flushed before promises, buffered proposals are appended after adoption unless a StopSign is present, or forwarded after follower sync. Established decisions constrain snapshot production and public reads, but correctness of delta base reconstruction remains an explicit local question.

open_details: Delta snapshot base reconstruction after decided-boundary update

core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority transition, old work, recovery, configuration and consumption paths have been traced. This is a navigation basis, not a coverage or correctness claim.
